notes: Seahawks QB Sam Darnold (quad, ribs) is out; Drew Lock starts, confirmed by Mike Macdonald.
Raiders rookie Fernando Mendoza, the No. 1 pick, makes his first NFL start after Kirk Cousins was traded to Minnesota. No calls on this game because Mendoza has almost no NFL sample.
